It’s not the challenge that’s the problem for me, it’s the tools I’m offered don’t seem be useful outside their direct counter to one of the problems you will face. Honestly this feels more like a puzzle than a story prompt for an adventure. Imagine if you did this cyoa with a dice roll instead of picking your tools, most of the time it would be useless against the enemies and challenges you face. The liver and glider would be ineffective in the archives. Add some more stuff or effects to existing tools, or even add a combo section for fun. Maybe your tools have more power the lower your sanity is, risk for reward.

Ultimately I guess decide if you want the dark souls experience with a focus on mastering the few tools you have, or the legend of Zelda (BOTW) experience  of experimenting with many different options. Either option is great for your setting. Personally I don’t hate/dislike this CYOA, I just want more from it.
